title: WhatsApp Builder Onboarding Workflow
description: AI-powered conversational onboarding flow for builders via WhatsApp. Collects builder information step-by-step and creates Owner + Subscription records with automatic contact updates.
features: Intent detection for builder registration keywords
Check existing builder registration to prevent duplicates
Multi-step conversation flow (company name → contact person → email → city → plan selection)
Contact record updates with company name
acceptance_criteria: Builder can register via WhatsApp conversation
result_summary: Complete WhatsApp builder onboarding workflow with AI-powered conversation flow. Collects builder details through natural conversation, creates Owner and Subscription records, and provides dashboard access. Ready for integration with message router.
notes: Requires BuilderOnboardingSession model in schema (or can use existing sessionStore service)
